findings.desc: CHK-001:edge:0 second clause — tolerates a bundle whose optional Authority fields are absent — has no concrete assertion. ReceiptBundle has no Authority fields (deferred), so the verifier trivially never fails on them, but no test case constructs a bundle with Authority fields present vs absent to assert the tolerance. The assurance-label half (r.assurance === local-key-single-host) IS asserted. Gap is untestable in this story; intent clause should reference the follow-up story.
findings.uncertaintyReason: The ReceiptBundle type has no Authority fields (explicitly deferred to a follow-up story), so it is ambiguous whether the intent clause refers to the current schema or the future one. The assurance-labeling half of CHK-001:edge:0 is fully covered. Untestable until Authority fields are added.
findings.resolvedReason: adversarial:0/edge:0 — Authority-fields-absent clause is untestable because Authority fields are deferred to a follow-up slice (out of scope); the assurance-label half of the intent IS covered by the smoke (asserts assurance==='local-key-single-host'). Audit-only low.

findings.desc: missing-test-coverage: receipt-bundle-contract-smoke.ts covers 8 tamper classes but omits a case for reason=digest_mismatch — step 5 of verifyReceiptBundleOffline (HEX_SHA256 check on outputDigest) is never exercised; a re-signed bundle with a malformed outputDigest would trigger it but no such case exists in cases[]
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b7ad42391: smoke now has a digest_mismatch tamper case (re-signed bundle with a non-hex outputDigest) reaching the digest check.

findings.desc: missing-test-coverage: receipt-bundle-contract-smoke.ts has no tamper case for reason=decision_not_pass — the verifier step 7 (bundle.decision !== pass) is untested; a properly re-signed bundle with decision=fail would be required to prove that check fires; the lying-agent section only exercises stale and signature_invalid
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b7ad42391: smoke now has a decision_not_pass tamper case (re-signed decision:'fail') reaching the decision check.

findings.desc: type-safety: receipt-bundle.ts:62 ReceiptBundleDecision = 'pass' | 'fail' | 'blocked' | string collapses to plain string because string is a supertype of all string literals — the literal union members are dead at type level, TypeScript will accept any string without warning, eliminating compile-time protection on decision values
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b7ad42391: ReceiptBundleDecision tightened to 'pass'|'fail'|'blocked' (dropped the | string collapse).

findings.desc: Canonicalization drops JSON null: normalizeSigningJson (authority-signing.ts:62) omits null + null array entries, so a post-signature mutation like hostVerdicts.push(null) (or nulling a field) still verifies and returns accepted:true — the signature does not cover all accepted JSON values. Fix: reject any null/extra/non-schema value before accepting (validate the bundle shape strictly), or canonicalize preserving null + array positions. Add this tamper case to the smoke. (Codex host-2; proven by runtime probe.)
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b7ad42391: added isStrictBundleShape (rejects null/null-array-entries/extra-keys/wrong-type) running before accept → malformed_bundle. hostVerdicts.push(null) after signing now REJECTED (independently re-verified). Smoke adds the null-push tamper case.

findings.desc: Check order: verifier interprets signed fields BEFORE verifying the signature — a post-signature binding.materialHash mutation returns reason=stale and a blanked headHash returns binding_incomplete, both BEFORE signature_invalid. Fix: verify signature presence + verifyCanonical over the unsigned view FIRST, then run semantic checks over the now-trusted fields. (Codex host-2.)
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b7ad42391: verifyReceiptBundleOffline now checks signature_missing + signature_invalid (verifyCanonical over unsigned view) BEFORE any semantic check (stale/binding/receipts/decision).

findings.desc: signerPublicKey is signed as data but never proven to equal the verifying key: a bundle signed with the trusted private key but carrying a different signerPublicKey is accepted. Fix: in buildReceiptBundle derive/validate the public key, and in verifyReceiptBundleOffline require bundle.signerPublicKey === context.publicKey. (Codex host-2.)
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b7ad42391: buildReceiptBundle DERIVES signerPublicKey from the private key; verifier requires bundle.signerPublicKey===context.publicKey (signer_key_mismatch) and verifies against context.publicKey. Smoke adds signer-key-mismatch case.

findings.desc: Receipt semantics too weak: a signed bundle with decision:'pass' but a receipt exitCode:1 / exitCode:-1 / empty command is accepted as ok — existing DONE validation treats nonzero receipt exit codes as blocking. Fix: require each receipt to have a non-empty command, exitCode===0, and a valid digest (new reason code, e.g. receipt_not_passing); add smoke cases. (Codex host-2; proven by runtime probe.)
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b7ad42391: each receipt must have non-empty command + integer exitCode===0 + sha256-hex outputDigest → receipt_not_passing. exitCode:1 / -1 / empty-command now REJECTED (independently re-verified). Smoke adds the cases.
